newsitem.title: JAPAN: DKB says to carry out measures to improve business.
newsitem.headline: DKB says to carry out measures to improve business.

text.p: Japan's Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank (DKB) on Thursday apologised for its involvement in the racketeer payoff scandal and said it wants to carry out measures to improve its business and make it more transparent as soon as possible.

"It is really painful that our former and current executives were arrested. We would like to apologise deeply to our clients and to the public," DKB Vice President Yoshiharu Mani told a news conference.
He added that in order to regain the public trust the bank's credibility which was severely hurt by the incident, the bank will cut off any "unclear ties".
He did not elaborate on what those ties were.
"I think the road to rebirth is difficult, but we will do our best," Mani said.
